<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>借<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>借<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>债<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>剩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shū</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 书念妇人接待以利沙

verses.text: <ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>丈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>楼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>榻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby>、<ruby>桌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>椅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>楼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lóu</rt></ruby><ruby>躺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wò</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shū</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt
